screening.reason: Inclusion 2,3: resting-state fMRI (ABIDE-I, NYU site) diagnostic classification (ASD vs TC) using a deep CNN (DarkASDNet).

evidence_spans.text: Our model’s outcomes unveil that our proposed method established state-of-the-art accuracy of 94.70% to classify ASD vs. TC in ABIDE-I, NYU dataset.
evidence_spans.claim: Main predictive claim: 94.70% accuracy classifying ASD vs TC in the ABIDE-I NYU subset.

evidence_spans.text: In our experiments, we used ABIDE-I data processed through the Connectome Computation System (CCS) (Craddock et al., 2013).
Among the 17 sites, we endeavor with the CCS-NYU (New York University Langone Medical Center) site.
evidence_spans.claim: Analysis restricted to the single NYU site of ABIDE-I.

evidence_spans.claim: Analysed NYU cohort: 184 total subjects, 79 ASD, 105 TC.

evidence_spans.text: data are selected from the ﬁlt_global preprocessing stratagem, which is band-pass ﬁltered (0.01–0.1 Hz) and spatially registered using a nonlinear method to MNI152 template space

The original 3D fMRI data has 73 slices per volume according to the data description of ABIDE-I. In our experiments, from the 73 slices, we contemplated the last 50 slices because of the precise sketches of the brain images.
evidence_spans.claim: 3D volumes were converted to 2D slices (last 50 of 73) for the CNN input.

evidence_spans.text: After testing our model for ASD classiﬁcation, we have achieved the highest accuracy of 94.7%, the precision of 94.5%, recall of 92.5%, f1-score of 95%, and the AUC score 94.703%.
evidence_spans.claim: Main performance results: accuracy 94.7%, precision 94.5%, recall 92.5%, F1 95%, AUC 94.703%.

evidence_spans.text: The raw data supporting the conclusions of this article will be made available by the authors, without undue reservation.
evidence_spans.claim: Data availability statement: available on request from the authors.

assessments.support: Table 2 reports the exact NYU-site cohort: 184 total, 79 ASD, 105 TC, with age and ADOS score ranges.
"we used ABIDE-I data processed through the Connectome Computation System (CCS)" with filt_global strategy specified; no atlas/ROI parcellation used since the model takes 2D slice images directly.
ASD/TC labels are taken from the ABIDE-I NYU phenotype file; the diagnostic instrument/criteria used by the site are not described in this paper.

No train/test split, cross-validation scheme, or held-out evaluation procedure is described anywhere in the text; a single accuracy figure (94.7%) is reported with no uncertainty estimate, and 3D volumes were sliced into 2D images per subject with no statement that slices from the same subject were kept together across any split.

risk_of_bias.summary: Cohort and pipeline well specified, but the paper never states how data were partitioned into train/test sets or whether subject-level separation was maintained when splitting per-slice 2D images, and reports a single-split accuracy with no cross-validation or confidence interval.

charting.specific_algorithms: DarkASDNet (modified Darknet-19 architecture, 20 convolutional + 6 max-pooling layers), compared against VGG16, MobileNetV2 and SVM baselines
charting.validation_methodology: Not reported — no train/test split, cross-validation scheme, or held-out evaluation procedure is described
charting.performance_metrics: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, ROC curve, AUC
charting.key_performance_results: Accuracy 94.7%, precision 94.5%, recall 92.5%, F1-score 95%, AUC score 94.703%
charting.dataset_openly_available: Partly — data availability statement says raw data will be made available by the authors on request; no participant list or analysis code repository found in text

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction study; ABIDE I, NYU site only, 184 subjects (79 ASD, 105 TC)
narrative_row.methods: CCS-preprocessed (filt_global) resting-state fMRI 3D volumes converted into 2D slice images, classified with a modified Darknet-19 CNN (DarkASDNet)
narrative_row.outcomes: DarkASDNet achieved accuracy 94.7%, precision 94.5%, recall 92.5%, F1-score 95%, AUC 94.703%, reported as outperforming VGG16, MobileNetV2, SVM and several literature benchmarks on the NYU subset
narrative_row.key_limitations: No train/test split or cross-validation methodology described; single-site analysis limits generalisability; data available only on author request, no code repository found
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Single-site (NYU) ABIDE-I subset with an explicit N and phenotype table, but the prediction pipeline lacks a stated validation scheme, limiting confidence in the reported accuracy.
